parameters.query: SELECT a.id, a.url, a.title, a.author, a.summary, a.key_points, a.topics, a.final_score, a.image_url, a.published_at, c.name as category, c.icon as category_icon, c.slug as category_slug, s.name as source_name FROM articles a LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE a.status = 'approved' AND a.final_score >= 0.6 AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND a.id NOT IN (SELECT nsa.article_id FROM newsletter_section_articles nsa JOIN newsletter_sections ns ON ns.id = nsa.section_id JOIN newsletter_issues ni ON ni.id = ns.issue_id WHERE ni.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours') ORDER BY a.final_score DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT * FROM sponsors WHERE active = TRUE AND issues_used < issues_booked AND (start_date IS NULL OR start_date <= NOW()) AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= NOW()) ORDER BY rate_per_issue DESC LIMIT 1
